column1: # s1571.tsv -- the mutations base#1571 (the mutation-roster matrix, one
# baseline per spec, one sandbox per worker slot, the witness filter and
# the seconds-weighted deal) requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh to
# report PINNED. One row per behaviour:
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new>, the contract of
# script/test/drivers/mutation_required.sh (base#1461): <old> occurs exactly
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.
# Each row is the one-line weaker implementation a base#1571 test claims to
# rule out, so the claim is re-checked by running that mutant on every run
# of the roster rather than once at review:
# - baseline-key-tree-hash: the --baseline-in key is the commit, not the
#   tree, so a baseline is refused for the same tree under a new commit.
# - slot-reset-hard / slot-reset-clean: a kept worker slot's sandbox is
#   not reset (tracked files, untracked files) before its next row.
# - baseline-per-row: every row runs its own baseline (--baseline-out),
#   none reads its spec's shared one.
# - filter-no-fallback: a --filter mutated pass that stays green is a
#   verdict, never followed by the whole spec.
# - deal-by-index: --shard deals rows in roster order, not heaviest first.
baseline-key-tree-hash
slot-reset-hard
slot-reset-clean
baseline-per-row
filter-no-fallback
deal-by-index
